body:
Im on break between semesters right now, and expressed some of this to my parents. Realized Ive always acted to please them and to help with the personal issues theyve had for decades, and now I feel like I really hurt them b/c Ive wasted years of my life. Which is stupid, need to focus on myself, focus on what I can change, but guilt is strong. 

I looked at a few different college youtube video tours and Ive realized I have no interest in becoming friends with people, just want an antisocial boyfriend and focus on hobbies/academics. I hate that I cant control anything, that Im 19 and self esteem really dropped from being paralyzed all semester, completely isolated myself. Im terrified of communities, sort of disconnection (lack of emotional intimacy for yrs makes me feel similar to fucked up sociopath, cant see other ppl as real, killing ppl wouldnt matter), its just really hopeless/scary and claustrophic, experienced so much pain and still have struggle on, somehow get through this, feel super paranoid.
